description: Add a price book item, or change one when item_id is given (owner or office). Items are a pick list for quote lines that workers write; they are never filled into a quote automatically.

cost_minor.description: What it costs the shop, in cents. Never shown to customers.

est_minutes.description: Tasks only: estimated labor minutes, for costing

kind.description: task: a flat rate task that bundles labor and parts at one price

markup_percent.description: Instead of unit_price_minor: price = cost times (1 + markup/100), rounded to the cent

member_price_minor.description: Tasks only: price for customers on an active maintenance plan, in cents. Not above the price. null clears it.

parts.description: Tasks only: the price book materials the task uses, for costing. Never shown as a price and never taken from stock on its own.

task_code.description: Tasks only: the shop's code, like AC-CAP. Unique in the shop. Empty string clears it.

unit.description: each, hour, foot, and so on

unit_price_minor.description: Price to the customer, in cents

warranty_note.description: Shown to the customer with the task, like 1 year parts and labor. Empty string clears it.

name: pricebook_saveItem
